name: Central Phuket bypass commercial band
notes: Primary modern commercial band around Central Phuket, Big C, hospitals, and bypass frontage where destination and retail-led charging should dominate the model.

name: Old Town civic and transport band
notes: Dense city-center band linking Old Town, Limelight, bus terminal approaches, hospitals, and government services.

name: Patong-Kathu tourism connector
notes: Mid-island connector between Patong tourism demand and the main urban spine; suitable for mixed roadside and destination charging logic.

name: Choeng Thale and Laguna lifestyle district
notes: Premium west-coast lifestyle district anchored by Porto, Boat Avenue, Laguna, and nearby residential compounds.

name: Airport and Thalang gateway corridor
notes: North-island gateway corridor combining airport access, Thepkrasattri roadside demand, and resort inflow.

name: Chalong south growth axis
notes: Retail-residential-tourism growth axis around Chalong, Market Village, Robinson, and routes toward Rawai and Kata.
